text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat!? Did you just say you forgot my 
birthday!? A dutiful soul like you would 
never...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that... I truly, honestly, 
um, yes, completely forgot.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I gave you plenty of hints beforehand, 
didn't I~?! You even took notes on it, 
right~?! This can't be real, it's a dream, 
an illusion~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh. Just kidding. I remembered, of 
course. Happy birthday to you."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
You're always getting the better of me. 
Just for today, I shall return the favor. 
...And so, to Sir No Reason—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Representing Funabashi, I, Furioso, have 
prepared some local sweets to celebrate 
your birth. Please, enjoy them.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho...! I am thoroughly impressed, 
Furioso-dono! To think you possessed such 
a playful spirit! And presenting such 
famous confections as a gift—you truly 
understand fine taste!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Truly splendid! Well, well, you got me 
fair and square!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, these Funabashi confections 
must be utterly delicious. Which makes 
them all the more terrifying...!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I want to savor Funabashi's hospitality to 
my heart's content, yet I fear I might 
devour it all in the blink of an eye...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Fufu— If it's not enough, please don't 
hesitate to say so. I'll prepare seconds 
right away.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~! As expected of Lord Furioso!! Both 
your strategy and spirit truly befit a 
ruler of the realm~!!
